protocol.visible_context: identical operational fields; no evaluator truth
protocol.single: one agent identity across all four stages
protocol.multi: four distinct role contexts exchanging structured findings
protocol.budget_policy: same whole-incident caps; actual utilization may differ
protocol.interpretation: controlled workflow comparison, not proof that agent count alone causes improvement

timing_note: Observed wall time includes concurrent batch contention; not an isolated latency benchmark.

paired_comparison.comparison: single versus multi; same four-stage tool-assisted workflow
paired_comparison.conditioning: Downtime differences use complete comparable pairs only; assess failure coverage alongside them.
paired_comparison.uncertainty: Exploratory paired resampling; repeats within a scenario are not independent new scenarios.
